$comment: Generated by scripts/build-spec.mjs from the component sources — do not edit by hand.
name: BadgeIndicator
whenToUse: A count or a “something new” dot on an icon, avatar or nav item: unread notifications, pending invites.
A tiny status mark where a Badge with a word doesn’t fit.

whenNotToUse.text: A status that needs a word (“Active”, “Expired”)
Live status next to a text label in a list
A number people need to read precisely

anatomy.description: a short `value`, an `icon`, or nothing with `dot`.

do.caption: Cap long counts (“9+”, “99+”) — the exact number lives in the list.

dont.caption: A four-digit count overflows the badge and says nothing more.

a11y: The indicator is visual: put its meaning into the name of what it sits on (“Notifications, 3 unread”).
A `dot` is hidden from screen readers — the parent’s label must say “new” or “unread”.
Not focusable and not clickable; the icon button under it is the target.
`pulse` rings three times and stops — under 5 seconds (WCAG 2.2.2). Use it for something that just arrived, never as a permanent state; it is skipped with reduced motion.

props.name: dot
props.description: Renders a plain dot instead of `value`/`icon` — takes priority over both.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon content (sized by BadgeIndicator, colored via currentColor). Ignored when `dot` is set.

props.name: pulse
props.description:
Draw attention to something new: two rings spread from the badge, three times, then
it rests (well under 5 seconds — WCAG 2.2.2). Change `pulseKey` (e.g. to the new
item's id) to play it again. Skipped with reduced motion.

props.name: pulseKey
props.description: Replays the pulse whenever it changes.

props.name: value
props.description: Qty/text content, e.g. '5' or '99+'. Ignored when `dot` is set; if `icon` is also set, `icon` wins.
